newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-STYLISH HINGIS MOVES INTO SEMIS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-STYLISH HINGIS MOVES INTO SEMIS.

text.p: Swiss teenager Martina Hingis moved into the semifinals of the Australian Open on Wednesday with an impressive straight sets victory over Romania's Irina Spirlea.
The 16-year-old fourth seed, who is aiming to become the youngest winner of a grand slam title in the open era, overcame a hesitant start to beat Spirlea 7-5 6-2 in just 70 minutes.
Hingis's win equalled her best performance at a grand slam tournament after reaching the same stage of the U.S. Open last year.

The Czechoslovak-born prodigy showed excellent temperament to wear down her eighth-seeded opponent from the baseline, displaying the all-round skills which have made her the odds-on favourite to lift the title after the tournament's top three seeds were eliminated in the first four rounds.
Hingis sealed the match in style with a backhand winner down the line. She will next meet American Mary Joe Fernandez, who beat Belgian Dominique van Roost earlier in the day. REUTER
